Name: Witchy Laundry
Author: cozysweetpotato
Description:
Cute witchy laundry for any kind of witch! There are 8 types available to choose from: Basic cottage witch, autumn, mushroom, soft, dark, star, ice, and reindeer. Let me know which one(s) you like the most and if you would love any other witchy types that weren't featured ♡

I am using the lovely Faedew reshade by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11471909]rosenfey[/url] in my screenshots as well as Wildflour's Cuter Artisan Goods by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303&pk_vid=f3c6545d9e42881717548619865f7d66]Wildflourmods[/url], Fairy Mushroom Tree by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lumiepop?gameId=1303]Lumiepop[/url], and Wildflower Grass Field by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty. 

[/url]This mod is part of a larger series I plan to make for cottage witches! The series will have a cozy cottagecore witchy vibe. 

Content Patcher required

I hope you enjoy this mod and thank you for your support ♡

Also consider checking out the other mods in this series like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35861]Spectral Cat[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35922]Spectral Bunny[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36165]Bread Bugs[/url]﻿, and more!
